boards.title: Your First Weekend at Hampden-Sydney College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: An under-21-safe first-weekend sequence mixing campus orientation, recreation, dining, history, and low-key social spaces.

cards.title: Enter Through the College Gate
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Find the campus threshold
cards.notes: Start at the named College Gate, confirm your position on the official map, and use the landmark to orient the rest of your route.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a recognizable campus landmark before navigating farther onto the Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney College’s official interactive map identifies The College Gate as a named campus location.
cards.access_notes: The College says its campus and facilities are privately owned; students and visitors must follow College policies.

cards.title: Read the College’s Material History
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Atkinson Museum
cards.notes: Visit before the afternoon closing, then use one displayed object or document to anchor the campus history you are learning.
cards.short_summary: Add historical context through artifacts collected to preserve Hampden-Sydney’s past.
cards.evidence_claim: The official museum page says the Atkinson Museum interprets Hampden-Sydney’s history and lists regular Tuesday–Friday hours of 10 a.m.–noon and 1–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours are Tuesday–Friday, 10 a.m.–noon and 1–5 p.m.; the page also notes late opening on game days.

cards.title: Settle In Over Friday Dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Pannill Commons
cards.notes: Use dinner to learn the dining-hall layout and meal-zone routine; check your meal-plan access before entering the serving area.
cards.short_summary: Make the main dining hall a practical early stop for learning campus routines.
cards.evidence_claim: The current student handbook lists Pannill Commons dinner from 5–7:30 p.m. Monday–Friday and explains that students receive one entry per meal zone.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year Friday dinner is listed as 5–7:30 p.m. Meal-plan and guest-access rules apply.

cards.title: Try a Low-Key Game at Brown
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Brown Student Center
cards.notes: Choose pool, ping-pong, or a yard game, and keep the stop flexible enough to introduce yourself without depending on a scheduled event.
cards.short_summary: Use the student center’s recreation areas for an easy, informal first-night activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s Brown Student Center page documents indoor and outdoor communal areas for pool, ping-pong, yard games, and relaxation.
cards.access_notes: Campus recreation space; availability may vary when rooms or equipment are being used for College activities.

cards.title: Map Out a Late Study Option
cards.subtitle: Friday night · Bortz Library
cards.notes: Locate the service points and a study area now, so you already know where to return when coursework begins to fill your evenings.
cards.short_summary: Turn a short library walkthrough into useful preparation for the first academic week.
cards.evidence_claim: The current student handbook identifies Walter M. Bortz III Library and lists academic-year Friday hours of 8 a.m.–6 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year Friday hours are 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; later hours apply Monday–Thursday and Sunday, not Friday.

cards.title: Walk a Section of Wilson Trail
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Three-mile trail system
cards.notes: Start with a manageable section, carry water, remain on the marked route, and postpone the walk if weather or trail conditions look poor.
cards.short_summary: Learn the wooded edge of campus through a conservatively paced morning walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney’s official Wilson Trail page describes a three-mile trail through campus forests with hiking and biking paths.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor trail conditions and daylight vary; stay on established paths and follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Play a Few Tadpole Holes
cards.subtitle: Saturday late morning · Campus disc golf
cards.notes: Begin with a few holes instead of committing to the full course, yield to other users, and watch for walkers where the route enters woods.
cards.short_summary: Sample the technical campus course while keeping the first outing short and adaptable.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s Outdoor Experience page identifies Tadpole Holes as an 18-hole disc-golf course weaving through woods near the High Adventure Course, practice fields, and Tadpole Hole lake.
cards.access_notes: The course is outdoors and described as technical; use appropriate footwear and defer to posted restrictions or organized activities.

cards.title: Learn Your Recreation Base
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · TigeRec
cards.notes: Check entry requirements, tour the available facilities, and choose a familiar activity rather than testing unfamiliar equipment without help.
cards.short_summary: Use a brief recreation stop to understand the fitness resources available during the term.
cards.evidence_claim: Hampden-Sydney says TigeRec gives students access to the Fitness Center, Leggett Pool, group fitness, racquetball, disc golf, and intramurals.
cards.source_title: What to Do at Hampden-Sydney College
cards.access_notes: Access is intended for eligible campus users; facility schedules, pool availability, and participation requirements can vary.

cards.title: Pause Overlooking Chalgrove Lake
cards.subtitle: Saturday early evening · Brown Student Center side
cards.notes: Use the deck or designated gathering area for a quiet reset, keep clear of restricted shoreline areas, and leave the space as you found it.
cards.short_summary: Build downtime into the weekend beside a prominent campus landscape feature.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s campus-living page depicts students on a large deck overlooking Chalgrove Lake and notes fire pits by the water at Brown Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Use designated gathering areas and observe any posted rules governing the deck, fire pits, shoreline, or water access.

cards.title: Plan a Clear-Night Observatory Visit
cards.subtitle: Saturday night · Scheduled access only
cards.notes: Check for an announced observing opportunity before walking over; if none is scheduled, save the location for a future clear-night program.
cards.short_summary: Close the sequence with a weather-dependent activity that requires confirmed access.
cards.evidence_claim: The official observatory page says the facility houses a 17-inch Ritchey–Chrétien telescope and is used on clear nights for classes, student research, and community observing.
cards.access_notes: No public drop-in hours are stated. Visit only for a confirmed class, research session, or announced community-observing opportunity.
